claim: ES:SENZ is located at Mietenkamer Straße 65, 83224 Grassau and holds three Michelin stars in the current Guide.
quote: ES:SENZ — Grassau · Mietenkamer Straße 65, 83224 Grassau, Germany

claim: ES:SENZ is the in-house gourmet restaurant at Das Achental resort in Grassau, run by chef Edip Sigl.
quote: es:senz – Ihr Sterne Restaurant am Chiemsee

claim: In March 2024 Edip Sigl and the es:senz team were awarded three Michelin stars — the only three-star restaurant in Bavaria.
The road distance from Grassau to Aschau im Chiemgau is roughly 13.5 km and the fastest taxi takes about 14 minutes.
quote: Grassau to Aschau im Chiemgau · Taxi · 14 min

claim: Boutique Hotel Residenz Winkler occupies a late-medieval complex in Aschau, formerly the village 'Hotel Post', at Kirchplatz 1; the building has 32 rooms and a Michelin-starred restaurant Epicures.
quote: Once known as the 'Hotel Post', the late medieval complex in the heart of Aschau was transformed with great passion into an elegant luxury boutique hotel by Heinz Winkler in 1989.

claim: After founder Heinz Winkler's death in October 2022 the Residenz lost both of its Michelin stars in the 2023 Guide; the kitchen later regained one star in 2024.
quote: Nach Heinz Winklers Tod: Residenz in Aschau verliert beide Michelin-Sterne

claim: Hotel Bonnschlössl in Bernau am Chiemsee occupies a 15th-century castle (built 1477) about a seven-minute drive from the lake; the actor Ferdinand Bonn converted the farmhouse into a small castle in the early 20th century.
quote: family-run hotel located in a 15th-century castle in Bernau, a 7-minute drive from Chiemsee Lake

claim: Bonnschlössl currently operates as ten luxury vacation apartments at Ferdinand-Bonn-Straße 2, 83233 Bernau am Chiemsee, with on-site wellness (steam bath, Finnish sauna, relaxation room) and park grounds.
quote: zehn luxuriöse Ferienwohnungen … Ferdinand-Bonn-Straße 2, 83233 Bernau am Chiemsee

claim: Farmhouse 1604 in Seethal (Übersee) is a listed stone fisherman's house with a 1604 foundation stone, today four apartments (95–230 m²) sleeping 2–8 each, with electric-boat lake access and outdoor sauna.
quote: denkmalgeschütztes Steinhaus … Farmers Home / Farmers Loft / Fishermans Home / Fishermans Apartment

claim: Chiemgauhof Lakeside Retreat in Übersee (Julius-Exter-Promenade 21) is a 28-suite lakeside hotel designed by architect Matteo Thun and a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
quote: luxury lakeside hotel … 28 exclusive suites … minimalist design by renowned architect Matteo Thun

claim: Übersee am Chiemsee sits about 4.8 km / 9 minutes by taxi from Grassau.
Inselhotel zur Linde on Fraueninsel has been welcoming guests for over 600 years and is one of the oldest inns in Bavaria.
quote: Inselhotel zur Linde — 600 Jahre Gastlichkeit auf der Fraueninsel im Chiemsee

claim: After the last scheduled crossing, the Chiemsee Schifffahrt night taxi runs on demand between Gstadt and Fraueninsel/Herreninsel until midnight; book by phone +49 170 2053542 roughly 30 minutes before departure.
quote: Nach der letzten regulären Kursfahrt können Sie das Nachttaxi täglich unter der Handynummer +49 (0)170 2053542 ordern … bis 00.00 Uhr

claim: Landhotel Alte Zollstation in Pittenhart is a 14th-century former salt-route toll station extensively restored in 2016, with 25 rooms and retained historic features (16th–17th-century wooden ceiling, carved staircase).
quote: bereits im 14. Jahrhundert erbaute … erhaltene historische Ausstattung

claim: Hotel & Gasthof Sperrer in Grassau village is a multi-generation family-run traditional Bavarian inn with attached hotel rooms.
Berghotel & Chalets Adersberg sits at 815 m on the Adersberg above Grassau with Chiemsee/Kampenwand views and was renovated in 2021; address Adersberg 2, 83224 Grassau.
quote: modern rooms and luxurious apartments are nestled amidst unspoiled nature between Bernau and Grassau, on the beautiful Adersberg mountain

claim: Das Achental Resort in Grassau is the property that houses ES:SENZ — Michelin describes it as 'a perfect representative of modern-rustic Bavarian hospitality' with alpine-chic rooms.
quote: a perfect representative of modern-rustic Bavarian hospitality

claim: TripAdvisor confirms Berghotel Adersberg is roughly 2.9 miles (4.7 km) from Grassau village centre and lists ES:SENZ among its nearby restaurants.
quote: located 2.9 miles from the center of Grassau … Nearby Restaurants: Residenz Heinz Winkler … Es:senz

claim: Landhotel Alte Zollstation publishes its address as Trostberger Straße 1, 83132 Pittenhart and presents itself as a Landhotel and traditional inn (Traditionswirtshaus).
